changes.title: No tilt house
items: No more tilt-shift blur in the treehouse: the rooms, branches and Terrace stay sharp, the blur easing back as you fly off

changes.title: Legends snore before party
items: Before the party, sleeping legends just snore: no dream bubble, and their quests wait for the party spell
Before the party there are no relic bottles out in the forest, and no ley line: both appear when you cast the party spell
Before the party the forest sounds as it does at night after a lost party
You can go to bed before the party: it counts as a lost night, and you wake to the next one

changes.title: Conga follows
items: When the night's won, the conga line follows you while you're on the ground in the home area, filing after you wherever you walk; fly up or go into the treehouse and it goes back round the dancefloor
